residuals.family: Pi's own lowercase presentation word 'unknown' marks a partial or unobserved reading, never a verdict
the reader adapter's success tone and complete coverage judge the render's envelope, never the query
a verdict re-spelled in another letter case is no token reading
a pass or an unknown said in other words is not read
a code comment (or a shebang line, trivia like a comment) naming the adapter is no trigger

surfaces the census does not drive (the runtime resultPreview, the dialog and card renderers - the drawer's forward -, the inspector evidence-store view (its pane tiers and other draws are R-UNDRAWN-TIER's), the reconcile core) are not judged: what they draw from the provider output, which R10 judges whole, is outside the census

an adoption spelling no adapter sequence (a generic reader of rendered rows) is no trigger, while what it puts on a driven surface is judged: the provider output whole for every case (R10), the node evidence, the observer and the inspector for each one-block case (R11-R13)
a file that is not a JS or TS module (a doc page, a Python or shell script, a configuration file, the lockfile) is not read by A1, which reads package.json alone among them

a name assembled from a part the spelling does not fold - any part but a string literal, a string literal type, or a template or + chain of them (parentheses seen through): a variable holding the word, a call, a cast such as as const, a type span such as string - is read with that part as one space; constant + chains, templates, template literal types and constant spans fold as spelled
a look-alike letter or an inserted invisible inside a word is not folded (NFKC folds the fullwidth forms)
an abbreviation of the producer or its adapter (RC, rc, RC_ADAPTER; an rc package in the manifest) is not read: every sequence spells two words or more
a sequence run together inside one word (QUERYEVIDENCE) is no run of words: a word breaks only at a case change, an acronym's last capital or a character outside a-z and 0-9
a name joined at run time from literal parts, by an array join or by a call (concat), is read part by part, never folded
an envelope reader whose code holds no REACTIVE_FIBER_CLI_SCHEMA identifier (a generic reader of a provider output's source.result.blocks, or one naming the constant in a literal) is not found by A1
no outside text spells the -s forms (passes, fails): the paradigm rule alone reads them, so removing its -s branch together with both -s words from every literal stays green
a reading a surface computed that equals one the producer emitted for the case reads as consuming it: F3 judges readings, not how a surface made them

the part and clause breaks are the census's own rule, not an outside text: an edit of the rule (a break dropped so that two clauses merge, a clause filtered out, a part cut short) together with the pins it changes still tiles the title once the quiet row goes too, the quiet row pinning every break's merge and so every part's clause count while it stands
a module outside src/, qa/, examples/ and the root (the test tree, whose censuses spell the adapter's words to judge them, test/helpers/ included) is not read by A1
a sequence spelled across lexemes (a property path, an element access, a nesting) is no lexeme's run: A1 reads each lexeme's own words
a sequence word in another inflection (reactive component, query views, unavailable blocks) is not the sequence: each word is matched as the producer spells it
a producer text in another letter case or with other spacing is not read: a producer text is matched as the producer spells it
a module drawing the inspector views that never names layoutInspector (a drawer under another name, a call through a literal, a star re-export) is not found by A1
a key given twice in one object of package.json is read as JSON.parse returns it, the last one (npm reads the manifest the same way): an earlier duplicate is not read

the zero-block render (the defer policy) differs from the neutral render by design (no block, partial coverage), so the baseline legs beside the provider compare the one-block cases only: a reading a surface puts beside the provider on the zero-block render is judged only by F1 and F2, for its verdict readings

the inspector's draws the census does not make are not read - its default tier (ascii absent or false), its pane tiers (panes), every other width or row count and every other state - so a line only they draw is read by no leg and no falsifier; the quiet row holds InspectorSize's members (width, rows, ascii, panes) to src, so a draw option src adds reds it until it is named
notPlain checks no array's prototype: an array that is a class instance (an Array subclass) passes, and what it inherits (an accessor, a method such as toJSON) is read by no leg

notPlain takes every canonical numeric key of an array for an index: one at or above 2^32-1 (4294967295) is no array index, so JSON and the string readings never read it, while a key that is no canonical numeric string (01) fails closed
notPlain and the readings read the keys a value lists: a name a value answers without listing it (a proxy's get trap) is read by no leg
